sloka: रामस्य एवम् ब्रुवाणस्य त्वरितस्य युयुत्सया ।प्रजज्वाल ततो वेदिः स उपाध्याय पुरोहिता ॥१-३०-८॥
transliteration: rāmasya evam bruvāṇasya tvaritasya yuyutsayā ।prajajvāla tato vediḥ sa upādhyāya purohitā ॥1-30-8॥

translations.english: While he was fracing up for a fight, the fire on the sacrificial altar with the officiating priests and spiritual guides suddenly brightened.
